about.summary: I think in systems. Whether it is an API contract, a database schema, or a deployment pipeline — I care about how pieces connect and how they fail gracefully.
about.extended:
Over eight years, I have moved between agency work and product teams. I prefer building products that solve real operational problems: dashboards that teams actually use, APIs that do not break at scale, and tools that respect the developer maintaining them.

Outside of code, I write about backend architecture and infrastructure. I believe the best engineering decisions are the ones you can explain simply.
